title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Kanmani hides from Anbu at the hospital and gets emotional seeing her baby during the scan. Anbu gets a glimpse of his child when the nurse accidentally drops her scan report.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
episodeTitle: Viji Gets a Lead on Her Missing Son
description: Viji and Ilamathi find a vital clue regarding her missing son through his silver chain marked 'A'. Kalamma is stunned as the discovery may bring them closer to the truth.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Abinaya finally gets a job at a supermarket after a long search to overcome financial troubles. Shanmugam praises Sarala for managing the household and supporting him.
